newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai-Nanjing expressway opens two years ahead.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai-Nanjing expressway opens two years ahead.

text.p: The new expressway linking Shanghai with the city of Nanjing to the west went into trial operation on Sunday, two years ahead of schedule, the Xinhua news agency reported.
The agency said the 274-km road would dramatically improve communication between Shanghai and the cities of Suzhou, Wuxi, Changzhou, Zhenjiang and Nanjing along its length.
Shanghai's city leaders on Saturday attended a celebratory meeting to congratulate workers on completing the project so quickly, it added.
